Search finds entities by their names, paths, titles, summaries, symbols
and labels. First the query, or a run of its words, is matched against
labels (names in all their spellings, package names, README titles, old
ids, and what people and glossaries added): an exact match goes to the
top. Then bm25 over the words (identifiers whole and split: gather_global
matches "gather global") and over trigrams of names and paths (substrings
and typos), fused by reciprocal rank; then your own project first, files
and symbols over doc sections, important entities up, and directories
kept out of the way (_x, archive, old) down unless --under is in one.
At most two results come from one file.

A question about two things (how project A and project B each do
something) can come in parts, on the pg store: the words cut by a lone |
("layout engine cache | build script cache"), or --query for each further
part. Each part is searched on its own over the whole tree, each gets
places among what the reranker reads, and each result is reranked against
the part that found it.

Each result: its id, kind and freshness; the absolute path to open (with
a line for a symbol or section); its summary; and what matched. The
labels used are printed first, and any word no entity mentions is named.

--budget fits the text to that many tokens (four characters a token,
default 1500): summaries are cut to a sentence, then the tail dropped,
and it says how many were left out. --json prints every result, unfitted:
{"query", "terms", "hits": [{"rank", "id", "kind", "file_kind",
"project", "freshness", "path", "line", "title", "summary", "why",
"untracked", "matched", "score", "explain"}], "mapping", "absent",
"candidates", "ms" (milliseconds per stage)}.

Usage:
  agent index search QUERY [flags]

Examples:
  agent index search "held message delivery"
  agent index search deliver --kind symbol --project alpha
  agent index search "wire layout" --under ~/dev/beta --budget 800
  agent index search "word wall" --explain

Flags:
      --budget int       Fit the text to this many tokens (0: no limit) (default 1500)
      --cold             pg store: search in this process even when agent index serve is up
      --config string    The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
      --corpus string    pg store: only these corpora, comma-separated: code, prose, memory, friction (default: all of them, grouped; code and prose for a --kind)
      --explain          Say which list found each result, and the priors applied
  -h, --help             help for search
      --json             Print the results as JSON
      --kind string      Only this kind: project, dir, symbol, section; or file, or a file kind (source, test, fixture, doc, config, build, data, asset, submodule), one row per file, a symbol or section counting for its file
      --lexical string   pg store: bm25 (pg_search), fts (native full text), both, or auto (default: AGENT_INDEX_LEXICAL, else [search].lexical, else auto: bm25 where the schema has its indexes)
      --limit int        At most this many results (default 10; the pg store's search.limit)
      --project string   Only this project
      --query string     pg store: another part of the question, searched on its own and pooled with the others (repeatable; or cut the words with a lone |)
      --rerank           pg store: rerank the top candidates with the cross-encoder ([reranker] in the configuration), even when it is off there
      --store string     sqlite or pg (default: AGENT_INDEX_STORE, else [store].kind in the index configuration, else sqlite)
      --under string     Only entities at or under this path

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
